claimText: The 'STUDENT' prefix shall also be used by licensed pilots undergoing renewal training involving solo flight under supervision.
rationale: All attempts agree on the extension of the 'STUDENT' prefix to renewal training contexts.
exactSourceQuotes: Note 3: Although intended primarily for use by ab initio students, the prefix shall also be used in other circumstances where, for example, the holder of a valid licence is returning to flying practice after a significant absence and is undergoing renewal training involving solo flight conducted as a student under the supervision of a flight instructor.
